We are looking for an experienced Oracle Utilities C2M Technical Lead with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Utilities C2M, CC&B, MDM, and OUAF. India Geo.
This is a techno-functional leadership role for someone who can lead and mentor a technical team while remaining actively involved in development, solution design, integrations, and complex technical challenges.
The ideal candidate should have experience delivering end-to-end Oracle Utilities implementations and a strong understanding of utility business processes.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead the technical design, development, and implementation of Oracle Utilities C2M, CC&B, and MDM solutions.
Act as the technical subject matter expert (SME) and drive architecture and solution design decisions.
Lead, mentor, and guide development teams through code reviews and technical discussions.
Stay hands-on with configurations, customizations, integrations, development, and troubleshooting.
Work closely with clients and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver scalable technical solutions.
Lead technical workshops, client discussions, demonstrations, and solution walkthroughs.
Design and manage integrations with third-party enterprise applications.
Ensure adherence to Oracle Utilities standards, development best practices, and quality guidelines.
Support effort estimation, technical planning, performance optimization, and project delivery.

Required Skills & Experience:
10–15 years of overall IT experience, with at least 8+ years in Oracle Utilities.
Strong hands-on experience with Oracle Utilities C2M, CC&B, MDM, and OUAF.
Experience delivering multiple end-to-end Oracle Utilities implementation projects.
Strong understanding of utility business processes, including billing, payments, meter management, customer service, credit and collections, and field activities.
Hands-on experience with Oracle Utilities technical components:
Business Objects (BO) and Maintenance Objects (MO)
UI Maps, Business Scripts, Service Scripts, and BPA Scripts
Zones, Portals, Batch Processes, Algorithms, and Plug-in Points
Strong technical knowledge of Java, J2EE, Groovy, XML, Oracle XAI, Web Services, and integration technologies.
Experience integrating Oracle Utilities applications with ERP, CRM, GIS, payment gateways, middleware, and other enterprise systems.
Knowledge of solution design, effort estimation, performance tuning, and production support.
Excellent communication, team leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
